SRC-038:R001.text: Determine whether parked_work is a known field emitted by an older SAIPEN generation.

SRC-038:R002.text: If durable historical semantics prove an exact deterministic migration, add it to the existing canonical legacy recovery/migration owner.

SRC-038:R004.text: Migration must be journaled, idempotent and one-attempt.

SRC-038:R005.text: Unknown/unprovable semantics must remain fail-closed with a precise RECOVERY_BLOCKED reason.

SRC-038:R006.text: Never permit manual canonical-state edits as the workaround.

SRC-038:R007.text: SAITULS must become BOUND_VALID after safe migration OR precise truthful RECOVERY_BLOCKED with no generic validation dead end.

SRC-038:R008.text: Read STATE/BOARD/LOG and identify the exact WAIT authority.

SRC-038:R009.text: Determine whether WAIT is genuine current operator/external wait or stale historical state.

SRC-038:R011.text: If genuine WAIT, continue must expose the truthful wait route rather than advertising runnable SCOUT work; if stale/recoverable, canonical recovery must resolve it before ordinary work is advertised.

SRC-038:R012.text: Do not bypass WAIT_BLOCKED merely to make tests run.
